title: helioscli-plugin — extensible plugin architecture (HeliosPlugin, HeliosPluginRegistry, load_from_dir)
author: forge
summary: Created the plugin-arch standalone crate at HeliosCLI/crates/plugin-arch/ with a HeliosPlugin struct implementing the Plugin trait from pheno-plugin, a HeliosPluginRegistry wrapping PluginRegistry with load_from_dir(path) for scanning *.so files, and a stub pheno-plugin crate at HeliosCLI/crates/pheno-plugin/ providing the Plugin trait, PluginError, and PluginRegistry. The plugin-arch crate is standalone (empty [workspace] in Cargo.toml) and depends on pheno-plugin via a path dependency. HeliosPlugin implements Plugin with name() and version() methods. HeliosPluginRegistry wraps PluginRegistry and adds load_from_dir() which scans a directory for *.so files and registers each file stem as a plugin name. All 2 spec-named tests pass and clippy is clean.

public_api.plugin_arch::HeliosPlugin: struct { new(name, version) -> Self } — implements Plugin from pheno-plugin with name() and version() methods
public_api.plugin_arch::HeliosPluginRegistry: struct { new() -> Self, register(plugin) -> Result<(), PluginError>, load_from_dir(path) -> Result<(), PluginError>, names() -> Vec<String>, get(name) -> Option<&dyn Plugin> } — wraps PluginRegistry and adds directory scanning for *.so files
public_api.pheno_plugin::Plugin: trait { name(&self) -> &str, version(&self) -> &str, init(&self) -> Result<(), PluginError> } — Send + Sync, object-safe plugin contract
public_api.pheno_plugin::PluginError: thiserror enum { DuplicateName(String), InitFailed(String) } — canonical error for registry operations
public_api.pheno_plugin::PluginRegistry: struct { new() -> Self, register(plugin), get(name), names(), init_all() } — name-indexed plugin store with duplicate rejection

dependencies.pheno-plugin: path = ../pheno-plugin (stub crate exposing Plugin, PluginError, PluginRegistry)
